pages.title: Folded Matter
pages.text: A mountain, or a battlefield, taken up and folded small. Made by the Dodecaract Excavator and the Omnipotent Edge, which fold what they gather into it; use it to unfold it.

What the $(item)Dodecaract Excavator$() and the $(item)Omnipotent Edge$() gather in bulk comes folded: one of these holds up to 16,384 items of 64 kinds, so a big job never fills your inventory or the ground with thousands of items. Use it to unfold it into your inventory; what does not fit stays folded. Only those two make it.
